Discipline.note: The full parent composition — legend, three labelled items, one selected — which is the only way the leaf item renders at all. Filled dot reads clearly against the line-grey ring.

WithDescriptions.note: Three budget bands each with a line of what it buys; the selected middle option is unambiguous and the items stay top-aligned to their first line.

Invalid.note: Nothing selected, aria-invalid on every item giving destructive rings, and one destructive sentence telling the reader what to do.

Disabled.note: Whole group disabled with one value still held; the selected dot stays visible through the fade so the held value is not lost.
